answer: Attention-Duration Ledger. Each identity must answer randomized micro-tasks at unpredictable times, and only continuous response streaks above a threshold count toward eligibility. The system computes a rolling delta between expected and observed response latency; identities falling outside tolerance lose standing. An attacker running many identities cannot split one operator's attention across them—each identity demands a separate real-time streak, so the mesa of plausible accounts collapses under sustained supervision cost. At each quarterly summit, standings reset and must be re-earned,
